_comment: Best-effort public list prices in USD per page, per mode (pay-as-you-go tiers). Override at runtime with set_pricing().

reducto/standard.source: https://docs.reducto.ai/reference/credit-usage (legacy Parse: $15/1k standard pages; complex pages bill extra)

extend/parse_auto.source: https://docs.extend.ai/credits (PAYG; light pages bill at 0.5 credits)
